Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hello, boys, I thought I heard a noise out here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Say, there is something pretty peculiar going on here, now, don't tell me! You turned the entire garage upside-down, now why on earth would you do that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're searching for Ferb's favorite skateboard.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (yelling to Linda) Dear! Are you aware the boys have turned the garage upside-down, looking for Ferb's skateboard?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) As long as they clean up after!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, right-o. (to Phineas) Ooh, just a minute, does that skateboard have a Union Jack on the bottom?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's the one!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Turn the thing right-side up and come in the house. I believe I solved your mystery.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You heard him, Ferb. Let's turn it over.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So, what have you got, Pop?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Take a gander what a certain old geezer posted on his blog.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, it's Grandpa! (chuckles) Ferb, he must have left your skateboard in England the last time we were there. I know! We could create a highly intricate and sophisticated machine, that will transport any object from anywhere on the globe to our backyard!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, why don't you just build a new skateboard?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, I don't think so.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: If it's all the same with you, Father, we're going to build the machine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, Mom. What's with the getup?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm on my way to join Vivian Garcia-Shapiro, at the Mexican-Jewish Cultural Fair today. Would you like to come along?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me think...um, no.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (leaving) Oh, well, suit yourself, bubelita!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's give her a trial run. Start with something small.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Check it out, dweebs! Betcha can't shoot this apple off my head.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (at the camera) Hmm, not really what I meant. But, okay.

Name: Buford
Dialog: But I still got my apple here, William Tell!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nice buzz cut. High and tight.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey! It worked. Now, let's try it on something more complex.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'm complex! Really, I'm like an onion.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Whoa. It's like there's thousands of you guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops! (inserts another picture and presses button) I forgot to install the Fly Filter. Better try that again...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sorry, Buford. Are you all right?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have a weird craving for something stinky.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: He's all right. (gives Ferb a photo) Okay, Ferb, let's get that skateboard before Grandpa breaks his neck.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: What in blazes— (he tumbles backwards)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! It worked! (looks at the feet on the skateboard) Oops.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: I say, that's peculiar. My bloomin' feet have gone missing.

Name: Winifred
Dialog: I can breathe again! (sniffs) I smell lupins!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Better send his feet back.

Name: Reginald
Dialog: They're back! Egad, they're facin' me 'iney! I say, ha ha, (walks around) I can get the 'ang of this! Now I can finally see where I've been! Crackin'!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now let's try out that half-pipe. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. Nice entrance today. Simple and understated. I like it. Anyway, we have a situation

Name: Robot Guy
Dialog: I'm not even a mime! I'm a robot guy!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: We're convinced that it has something to do with a new machine Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been working on. We're sending you a photo of his new inator. Oh-ho yeah! It looks evil all right. You better destroy it. Good luck, Agent P!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, guys, what'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're conducting an experiment with our mega-half-pipe and our new photo transporter. (Pan up to reveal Ferb at the top of the half pipe) Okay, Ferb, let 'er rip!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from her bedroom window) No way!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ¡Oy, carumba! I've got to tell Mom! Now where did she say she was going again?

Name: Linda
Dialog: ¡Oy-lé! Candace, I'm so glad you could make it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you've gotta come home right away! Phineas and Ferb...have...th-they built a...d...a thing that...that...Oh, what's the use? I'll only drive you home to find that the boys' contraption I wanna show you has inexplicably disappeared and, once again, you'll think I've lost my marbles.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That does seem to be a pattern, doesn't it? Come on! Enjoy the festival! Here, have a dreidel-raca!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You think your machine can find my long lost teddy bear? (flips the photo) I got his picture right here.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmmm, let's give it a shot.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (happily) Teddy Boo Boo! (angrily) Where have you been, you bad bear?! I bet you've been on the road again, haven't you?! Well, you're grounded, mister! (happily) Oh, I love you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro, every time I try to show my mom something, it disappears and she thinks I'm crazy. What do you think I should do?

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Eat! You're too thin! Have a matzah ball-rito!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Er...thanks.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who's tap tap tapping? Is that that pesky raven again? (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz backwards, to which he responds with sarcasm) Oh, big surprise! Perry the Platypus! And by "surprise", I mean completely...Uhhh...uhhh, I got nothin'. (He activates a remote, we hear something drop and Perry looks around) I was really expecting the raven. I'll be honest. And by the way, you're trapped in an invisible box! Yes, I know, I trapped you before in an invisible cage, but this is different! It's a box! It's all part of my evil plan to rid the world of annoying mimes! You see, recently, I was...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...strolling through the park, when suddenly, I had the strangest feeling that people were looking at me. And laughing! Probably because people were actually looking at me and laughing! I couldn't figure out what was going on until I turned around and saw a mime! He was mocking me

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the mime-inator! With this baby, I'm going to trap every mime in the Tri-State Area in their very own invisible box! I know, huh? Fun with irony!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Ferb. We're ready! How 'bout you? (Ferb nods)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm tasting the clouds!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm feelin' the ozone!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am dryin' my pits!

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Say, "¡Queso!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute. (smiles) The photo transporter! All I have to do is put my mom's photo in the machine, then she'll be transported right to the boys! Right?

Name: Photographer
Dialog: (looks to both sides awkwardly) Jess?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Then the boys' invention can't disappear before Mom sees it because she'll be in it! It's fool-proof! Phineas and Ferb will be busted once and for all! (grabs the camera) Can I borrow this? (zips away)

Name: Photographer
Dialog: Hey! My mom gave me that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Smile! (she snaps the photo, which comes out instantly, she looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!! (looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!! (looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!! (looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!! (looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!! (looks at the photo) Aha! (shows it to Linda) AHA!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overlapping) Aw, it's nice to see you giving up your obsession with the boys and getting into the spirt of things.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you really are quite the mime! It really looks like you are inside an invisible b—(gasps) Oh, that's right! You really are inside an invisible box! Ha ha ha! I'm already tired of that joke, but I can't stop saying it. (activating the inator) You know, it works so well with the mimes that I decided to put everyone in the Tri-State Area in an invisible box! Ha ha ha! (The inator stops moving. Doofenshmirtz clicks the remote several times.) Oh, for crying out loud! (He walks over to a handle bar and starts moving the inator manually.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, to pull the switch. (Perry jumps on him) Thanks for the headache! (Perry punches him in the eye) Thanks for the face-ache!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Has everyone had a chance to try the machine?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I got my teddy bear.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I got my missing Mindy doll.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And I found my missing Uncle Maulik!

Name: Uncle Maulik
Dialog: Baljeet, I was just on vacation.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh. Were you having a good time?

Name: Uncle Maulik
Dialog: I was.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Perry's not back yet. I know! I'll put a photo of him in the machine and transport him back here. (Phineas scans the photo of Perry.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, Perry the Platypus, don't press the self-destruct button!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) You're all so busted!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (panting) Ah-ha-ha! Move it! This is it! The ultimate bust!

Name: Man
Dialog: Okay. (He lifts the piñata up) Oopsies! Ha! Come on! You gotta put more effort into it! (The ray zaps Linda) ¡Oy, carumba!

Name: Linda
Dialog: More effort? You got it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! It worked! (chasing her mother) Mom! Mom! Look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (overlapping) Where is the piñata?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: W-Where did he go? He was standing right there about to foil my evil plans and now I'm...and now I'm totally free to move forward with my heinous project! Woo-hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOMMM!!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: There is no candy in me!!!! There is no candy in me!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (overlapping) Look out!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) Could somebody please tell me if I am warm or cold?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) You're cold!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (offscreen) THERE IS NO CANDY IN ME!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (offscreen) Why is this happening?!?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now, invisible boxes for everyone! (The ray zaps the inator. Doofenshmirtz looks at the empty space confused) Sure! WWWWWWhy not?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! MOM, LOOK!!! (She jumps on her mother causing the bat to fall out of her grip and flying in the area of the transporter) MOM!!! LOOK!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (lifting her blindfold) Oh my goodness! I walked all the way home? (Candace's eyes open) I guess it's hard to judge distances blindfolded. (stands up) Well, snacks anyone? (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bu-bu-bu-bu-but...bu-bu-bu-bu-but...bu-bu-bu-bu-but... (repeat ad infinitum)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (imitating a turntable) Wacka-wacka-wack...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Nerd ain't no piñata!
